ai_review.summary: libyang 0.16 line predates the vulnerable lyd_meta/lyd_parser_set_data_flags subsystem (introduced in the 2.x rewrite; absent at upstream commit 6ed7a85 = 0.16.46, 2018-10). CVE range <5.4.3 is historically over-broad; the vulnerable behavior does not exist in this version.

libyang 0.16 line predates the vulnerable lyd_meta/lyd_parser_set_data_flags subsystem (introduced in the 2.x rewrite; absent at upstream commit 6ed7a85 = 0.16.46, 2018-10). CVE range <5.4.3 is historically over-broad; the vulnerable behavior does not exist in this version.

VERIFIED bounds from public source: openssl-3.4.0 has the vulnerable PKCS7_verify cleanup, openssl-3.4.6 has the fix, FIPS is orthogonal (default-provider libcrypto). But '3.4-fips3.1' is a Palo Alto vendor build string, not an upstream version, so the exact base patch (3.4.0-3.4.5 vulnerable vs 3.4.6+ fixed) is not publicly resolvable — needs the actual PA build ('openssl version -a').

Source-verified: the vulnerable doProlog pre-image in expat/lib/xmlparse.c is present at R_2_1_0 and the fix is absent (PATCH_NOT_FOUND, PREIMAGE_PRESENT). SBOM->build binding user_asserted -> LIKELY_TRUE_POSITIVE (high).

Source-verified: fix absent at v2.1.128; unlike the 0.16 line, the vulnerable lyd_meta metadata-list subsystem exists in the 2.x line. Main-file fingerprint match was weaker (version drift), so confidence medium; SBOM->build binding user_asserted -> LIKELY_TRUE_POSITIVE.

Source-verified via verify-source (native glasswing-fingerprint): the vulnerable PKCS7_verify pre-image (the caller-owned indata BIO free before the fix) is present in the upstream openssl tree at this version and the fix is absent (PATCH_NOT_FOUND, PREIMAGE_PRESENT). Range-affected AND upstream code presence confirmed; the SBOM->Palo-Alto-build binding is only user_asserted (a vendor backport cannot be ruled out from the version string), so LIKELY_TRUE_POSITIVE (high), not CONFIRMED.
